Office Fools

A time-stop puzzle game built in 10 days for April Fools’ Day Jam 3, where it placed seventh on the judges’ list.

  • Unity
  • C#
Overview Jam comments (7)

Project overview

I built a first-person interaction loop for talking to coworkers, picking up and throwing objects, and pulling pranks while time is frozen. The watch and its dialogue tie those interactions together.

  • 7th on the April Fools’ Day Jam 3 judges’ list
  • 8th overall and 5th for Fun in community voting
